title: SI-Bone Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $55.7 Million, Up 14.5%
summary: SI-Bone reported Q3 2026 revenue of $55.7 million, up 14.5%, a net loss of $3.6 million, and reaffirmed its 2026 revenue guidance of $231M to $233M.
body_markdown:
Gross margin was 79.3%, compared with 79.8% a year earlier. Operating expenses increased 9.7% to $48.5 million, while the operating loss improved by 19.2% to $4.4 million from $5.4 million. Net loss improved by 20.7% to $3.6 million, or $0.08 per diluted share, from $4.6 million, or $0.11 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was $3.0 million, up from $2.3 million, and cash from operations was $5.9 million. Cash and equivalents stood at $146.3 million as of September 30, 2026, compared with $145.9 million as of June 30, 2026.


## Why It Matters for SIBN


The release compares the updated outlook with the guidance SI-Bone issued on August 3, 2026. The company kept its 2026 revenue guidance at $231 million to $233 million, approximately 15-16% growth, and its gross margin guidance at approximately 79.0%. Based on its year-to-date operating expense trend, it lowered its expected operating expense growth to approximately 10.5% at the revenue midpoint, from approximately 12.0%, and left its adjusted EBITDA guidance unchanged.


The company linked the quarter to its physician base and products. It reported 1,770 active U.S. physicians, growth of about 16%, and said new MS-DRGs for complex spinal fusion procedures using iFuse Bedrock Granite took effect in October, increasing average hospital inpatient payments by up to about $50,000 per qualifying procedure. "Robust third-quarter growth in procedure volumes and active physicians underscores rising demand for our diversified and differentiated platform technologies," Chief Executive Officer Laura Francis said in the release.
